summary: Added core.task_stats (counts plus sorted per-tag open counts) and the cli stats subcommand with --tag. cmd_stats resolves today first, validates open tasks' due dates, then tags (open tasks, or all tasks with --tag), then priorities, reusing bad_tags/bad_priority, then prints the lines.
assumptions: Relied on store.load returning [] for a missing file without creating it, and stats never calls store.save.
Under --tag, the tag check runs over all tasks in file order, so the first bad-tag task by file order is named.
The git branch `stats` already exists per git status; no branch work was done.
